not successful All in all university degrees are essential and helpful but do not always give a guarantee for the real world

Title: Feminists Have Done More Harm to the Cause of Women Than Good
text_field: Feminism commenced as an epochmaking movement aiming to establish a common ground for women to have the same rights as men in every sphere of society First wave of feminists aim was to have the right to vote and be elected which rapidly evolved into fighting for equal treatment in the workplace and establishing more autonomous female individuals in the society Today main goals seem to have been achieved in western society however it is not the case throughout the world Interestingly nowadays there are heated discussions on social media ruled by feminists and antifeminists who are pro or against the idea of feminism still being indispensable Both groups have their right arguments but I will elaborate on how feminism is seen by young people today and will comment on campaigns that were launched on the social media as well as expatiate on the celebrities who have stood up for feminism	Nowadays a big number of young people approach feminism under different lights Mainly believing that the ultimate equality between sexes is achieved some people consider feminism as a redundant movement in Western civilization They claim that modern feminism reinforces patriarchal hierarchy just by accepting the status of victim National Review writer French defines modern feminism as an ideology supported by a small minority that strive to elevate  R  The discussions were heated when Matt Taylor a scientist at European Space Agency went live while wearing a shirt featuring illustrations of seminaked women Some feminists harshly criticized him while many others reacted to the criticisms defending Taylors important role during the landing mission and accused the feminists of cherrypicking In the end Tylor had to apologize for the shirt R  Eventually these kind of disputes lead to create a negative emanation around the notion of feminism  	Meanwhile recently social media became a significant platform for discussing equality issues Many groups have emerged either defending or disparaging feminism in one way or another One group Women against Feminism became exceedingly popular among young women who declare being against the norms of modern feminism mainly because of the aggressive attitude of contemporary feminists Some of their reasons are  R  Converesly another popular group got organized under the hashtag YesAllWomen where everyone shares their experiences on sexual hatred harassment and even rape The amount of the tweets reporting on these issues was appalling It evolved into an international manifesto revealing that there is still misogyny going on in the society By and large currently there are supporters of absolutely different ideologies even though in the heart of their nature both groups celebrate equality and call for awareness in the society	Alternatively many celebrities have decided to take sides on this neverending discussion whether feminism is needed or not Beyonce has recently written an essay called Gender Equality is a Myth where she especially draws attention to the inequality in pay rates in the US pointing out the fact that  R  Likewise Emma Watson delivered an inspirational speech as a UN Women Goodwill Ambassador By introducing the campaign HeForShe she draw attention to the necessity of feminism for achieving gender equality R  As a consequence the campaign became influential worldwide involving hundreds of thousands of men and women Contrarily there are also celebrities who openly avoid the F word Many of them like Shailene Woodley Lana Del Rey and Carrie Underwood declare not being feminists mainly based on the negative connotation the word has Interestingly the only point of disagreement seems to be whether they consider the word feminism as positive or negative Other than that both sides celebrate gender equality and respect  	In conclusion it is doubtless to say that the heated discussions over the necessity of feminism will remain popular in the near future There seems to be a positive improvement in the viewpoints of the people in this century and the biggest disagreements occur on a pragmatic basis Accordingly when gender equality is concerned there is much ado about nothing as both those who are pro and against feminism in fact advocate the same policies and aims

Title: The prison system is outdated; no civilized society should punish its criminals. It should rehabilitate them. Do you agree or disagree with the statement above?
text_field: The topic or sentences as It is high time to shift focus from punishment to rehabilitation may seem lofty at first sight but once contemplated they are not downtoearth Any civilized society needs to have a system to uphold and maintain peace and security The most popular solution that strikes the mind of the public when speaking of committing crimes is to punish criminals by imprisonment However some people think that ignorance is the root of all evil and believe that providing right education can deter criminal activities  The common belief about prisons is that they exist in order to punish criminals to keep imminent threat away from the society and reform the character of those who have broken the law Prisons are confined spaces which are depressing and violent most of the time For some immediate or distant prospect of incarceration acts as an effective deterrent against committing crimes As to the second justification imprisonment seems to be necessary in order to stop criminals from doing more harm __serial killers kidnappers smugglers etc to name a few Imprisonment can be rehabilitative if it can serve as an opportunity of contemplation Taking the three justifications into consideration a big question may pop up in our minds Can prison sentences make criminals better people Do prisons serve the purpose they are meant to serve _their rehabilitative mission The questions are left for experts to answer Some people believe that prisons are Schools for crime In their point of view imprisonment is a hurried easy and naïve solution They claim that inmates in prison are with other members of the crime family and can actually learn new and better ways of committing crimes I guess it seems better to put it this way that prisons are potentially schools for crime if they are not managed based on taxonomic principals People come from different backgrounds In order to have a humane and effective penal system I suggest that the origins of criminal behavior should be tracked and then each group of highrisk and lowrisk offenders should receive the proper punishment or treatment  Incarceration is a shortterm solution for many offenders Rehabilitation could be a longterm solution to help offenders become lawabiding citizens Once inmates have passed the first part of their rehabilitation lessons it is not recommended to keep them segregated from the general public since living in a place where crime is the way of life of its people may neutralize all the rehabilitative activities However offenders are still potentially dangerous and their progress has to be closely monitored Generally speaking in all steps taken to help criminals to come to a peaceful state of mind and to become useful members of the society the tendency should be moving from disciplining of the body to disciplining of the soul to put it in Michel Foucaults words Education and vocational training can promote sense of responsibility and selfesteem in offenders and can also help them learn a skill for use in the society  Analyzing both views we are not exactly sure whether imprisonment or rehabilitation can separately be considered guaranteed behavior modification techniques I would like to say that rehabilitation may help prevent crime in the society to some extent However imprisonment seems to be necessary to put the fear of imprisonment into potential criminals

Title: Can the Use of Performance Enhancing Drugs in the National Football League Be Stopped?
text_field: Being an athlete in the National Football League NFL these days is a difficult and a demanding task Athletes not just from the NFL but from other sports as well turn to PEDs Performance Enhancing Drugs in order to repel severe physical contact and injuries which are in the nature of their respective sports When it comes to American Football it should be noted that it is a sport which requires athletes to be at a peak physical condition and to be ready to perform at a high level In my estimation athletes should not be allowed to use illegal substances Instead the NFL should try to limit injuries by banning helmet to helmet hits and hits after the play is over Thus the issue of PED usage the penalties for using them and the attitude of the NFL towards this matter will be further elaborated on in this essay 	The use of PEDs in the NFL has been an ongoing issue in the NFL for a long period of time Players use them not only to be more competitive and to fortify themselves from injuries but also to gain a mental edge over their opponents However as we learn from NFL analyst A Gbajabiamila  R  Yet another reason why some athletes who are considered to be near the end of their career or past their prime use PEDs is so they can be able to play on the same level with the younger athletes There is a limited number of athletes that can overcome the ferocity of a single NFL season and even they sometimes need extra help to get better to get through the season or secure a roster spot And when they feel helpless they turn to PEDs for help hoping not to get caught R  Ultimately I am of the mindset that lack of conditioning both financial and career ambitions as well as health perseverance are the main reasons athletes turn to using performance enhancing drugs 	When it comes to NFLs drug policy many revisions have been made in order to reach the goal of creating an equal playing field for the athletes The drugtesting program includes provisions under which Title: Is the Lack of Empathy in Children a Taboo or a Reality?
text_field: Defining the term Evil has been one of the most challenging tasks throughout the human history Being considered as the counterpart of good it seems almost impossible to extinguish it thoroughly On a philosophical ground good and evil would be dichotomies however in real life people tend to follow the path of good and reject the evil It is not hard to imagine why people decide that being good should be the only possible way as being evil would destroy the society Nonetheless various reasons lead some people to become evil At this point one must not forget that an evil person was once a child too Therefore it is essentially important to understand the development of evil people through the early stages of their lives if we want to understand the reason why they decide to go against the society Therefore I will try to elaborate on the modern definitions of evil focusing on evil at child development stage and putting the objective on societys role on this matter  	Primarily in order to analyse the role of evil in children one must try to give a good definition for it Evil has been explained by all of the religions and philosophical views However in the modern era it needs to be defined in accordance with the contemporary doctrines For instance one of the founders of the modern philosophy Immanuel Kant defines evil as craving for something forbidden even though one knows it is not right R  Moreover Kant believes that evil exists in all human beings and is affiliated with free choice R  On the other hand Cambridge professor BaronCohen interrelates the terms evil and lack of empathy and creates his own system of six levels of empathy in which zero empathy is also divided to positive and negative Zeropositive people are conditioned with autism or Aspergers syndrome and although they do not possess empathy they can follow the rules of society Contrarily zeronegatives are people with borderline personality disorder antisocial personality disorder and narcissistic personality disorder These people are capable of harming other people and do not feel guilt after that R  Another approach for the definition of evil comes from the Psychology professor Ana Frichand who considers the notion of evil nearly impossible to be defined as its position in the sphere of psychology is unsteady and extremely complex and no definition could thoroughly encompass its meaning for humans R  In my mind it is high time to replace the oldfashioned term evil with a more reasonable and thorough identification bearing in mind that the more we know about it the better we can deal with it and correctly treat it 	Consequently understanding evil becomes even harder when we concentrate on its role in child development Namely the first thing that should be decided on is whether evil traits are inborn or acquired later in the society BaronCohen through his study on the lack of empathy states many neural based empathy researches conducted on the zeronegative patients which have led to a conclusion that there are various abnormalities within their empathy circuit These abnormalities usually have innate or genetic nature but in the end what triggers them is the environment the children gets exposed to at the development stage Thus the role of the parents is highly important because facing violence sexual or physical abuse alcoholism emotional neglect and rejection at this stage facilitates children becoming future borderlines Additionally parental rejection and early stress play a determining role on children with Conduct Disorder as they may evolve to become future psychopaths R  Recent studies have concentrated on callousunemotional traits that are treated as a type of psychological disorder in children These children fit in perfectly to BaronCohens zero degree of empathy as they tend to be cunning deceiving and do not posess compassion R  Therefore it is inevitable to acknowledge that the main problem is not whether evil is innate or not the main problem is identifying the malicious traits and starting with the treatment immediately BaronCohen and Frichand both hold similar opinions that if the correct treatment starts at the correct time if the environment of the child is suitable to carry the child on to his development path change is highly possible R  Accordingly taking the easy way and saying that malicious traits are inherent and nothing can be done to change the destiny of these people does not seem as the best decision to me on the contrary I strongly believe that with the correct attitude these children can be adapted to the social life 	Ultimately the society in which the child grows up plays the essential part on the childs development Mainly the majority of people who lack empathy state that they had serious issues inside their families when they were children R  Bearing in mind that the society is not a sterile chamber apart from the family structure other institutions and establishments have a strong effect too For instance a school atmosphere may not be ideal for every child so it is a very difficult task to create the most compatible ambiance In addition to this assuming that a child has already commited a crime our attention should concentrate on the justice system According to BaronCohen imprisonment is necessary only for the most serious crimes R  In the same way Jessica S Henry goes against children being punished by laws organised for the adults She holds the opinion that no matter how great the crime is the children criminals should be tried by the juvenile justice system which shall meet the psychological behavioral and emotional needs of children She argues with scientifical facts that children do not having fully formed brains and are still not mature enough to make rational decisions instead they are subject to change R  Moreover in my mind the justice system should endure a transformation in a way to redound those children to the society than to darken their lives 	By and large the results show that doing away with evil is a much more complex process than what I have imagined Firstly it is not a concrete thing to define easily and conclude about its elements Secondly although modern psychology has made a big progress in identifying and giving solutions for the treatment of malicious traits in children it still has a vague starting point and does not hold the promise that these traits would not reveal themselves again Thirdly despite the thorough awareness towards evil the society is still not able to create the most suitable environments to treat the disorders I personally do not expect this to change for a very long time In the end I invite everyone who consider themselves as a part of a society to look around and think about the children they know and try to imagine them as grown ups Surprisingly we hold the opportunity to have influence upon their future sometimes little actions may result in great hopingly positive conclusions

Title: All armies should consist entirely of professional soldiers: there is no value in a system of military service
text_field: People have enlisted in armies ever since ancient times up to today Compulsory military drafting or the more popular term nowadays known as conscription has had a colossal impact on countries communities and most of all people throughout centuries However in this day and age in most countries military service is not compulsory Even though nowadays the general idea is that nobody should be forced to enlist for the army and that there is no need for a system of military service there are those who present their arguments in favor of it	As it pertains to the points against the idea of a system of military service the issue of gender and sexism immediately comes to mind Historically the system of compulsory military service has only applied for men Many especially feminists claim that the nature of the military service system is patriarchal Philosopher David Benatar states that  R  This he believes  R  Another valid argument against the value of the system of military service is that no person male or female is to be forced to enlist in the army against their will The notion that young people are mandatorily forced to join the military makes this comparable to slavery The government and the state are meant to serve the individual not the other way around and this does not go along with the theory of democracy Former US presidential candidate and influential politician Ron Paul writes that  R  Consequently an active system of military service deals an immediate blow to the economy of the particular country The training facilities and camps as well as the cost for the remaining necessary equipment and tools that need to be provided may not prove to be very beneficial in terms cost and worth Overall the above mentioned points against the compulsory system of military service are not to be overlooked	There is another side to the understanding of the value of the system of military service For centuries authorities in charge have applied the mandatory enlisting of people to their armies in order to protect themselves and their countries This is still the case nowadays especially in the Middle East where countries like Syria and Israel rely upon this system to establish a stout defense from the hostile neighbors Moreover many people consider enlisting in the army to be an act of loyalty and patriotism It is viewed as noble brave and patriotic to serve as a soldier Many believe that armies should not consist entirely of professional soldiers on the contrary people who are fit should sign up and help in keeping their country safe Along with instilling national loyalty within the youth the system of military service can arguably make the young people more disciplined mentally stronger more mature and some go as far as saying that it is a way to keep the young males from unemployment and the streets In his piece called The Moral Equivalent of War William James notes that  R  Basically moral motives such as loyalty patriotism and the idea that serving for ones nation is considered noble and it brings discipline mental strength and maturity in the youth These are considered to be the notions that approve the existence of a military service system	All in all if we are to regard both views as it pertains to whether the system of military service needs to be mandatory or not it is safe to say that there are valid arguments on both sides However the modern war technology which is developed nowadays arguably eliminates the need of a military consisting of soldiers Moreover the points against the mandatory drafting of soldiers in the army outweigh those that are in favor due to the fact that no individual should be forced to serve in the army as it is against their freedom of choice and does not cope with modern democracy

Title: Most university degrees are theoretical and do not prepare students for the real world. They are therefore of very little value
text_field: Some people claim that having a university degree is necessary if we want a brilliant future whereas others claim that it is not so important because these degrees do not prepare students for real life People who consider university degrees as an important factor to get a job and have a good future believe that a university degree will supply them any position they want After graduating they will not be unemployed because they have a degree However a university certificate is insufficient to go further in their careers because we witness that a lot of highlygraduated students are unemployed Such people that they attend university get a degree in vain there is no mean to have it or not It is also known that despite their low degrees most of graduates who are in high positions are accorded preferential treatment by superior people like authorities so most university degrees are of little or no value in some peoples opinion In my opinion another important reason is that people are not satisfactory or capable in a branch even though they are educated on this branch in university Namely a certificate does not show that a graduate is very good at the branch she is specialized Such people who are not in the aim of only graduation might not be welleducated or might try to get degrees just to heighten their degrees of certificates In such cases a university degree cannot be considered as a criterion for a position The most important another reason of having university degrees little value is  I think that they do not prepare students for the real life That is to say  a university degree is far away from the real life itself of a student Students are educated according to some schedules in universities All perspectives or different ideas of any branch are taught to students but they are sometimes taught some subjects they never may use in their lives but only in university life to pass the exam  or most subjects are not related to the realism of life For example students who are in the Medical Science are taught just theoretically in the first three year of sixmore year education They are given slides or data and asked to memorize them in order to pass exams at the end of each unit called TEM Their job is related to human body but they are not informed about how human body functions practically whereas they are wellinformed theoretically In the fourth year of education  they start to have internship Unfortunately they realize that they have forgotten what they are taught up to that moment The first three years of their education in university have been in vain However when they are asked to how to rule out that problem it is suggested that the internship should be started in the second term of the first year to be should be superior to that of theory People do not learn how to live just by memorizing or listening to others experiences but learn when they really experience the life itself To sum up I do not mean that university degrees are unimportant for individuals by saying that they are of little value but mean that if students are lack of practice a university degree may not be a beneficial one We should accomplish this aim universities give heavy tasks and responsibilities to students to be handled They manage to handle these tasks and responsibilities just to be able to pass the exams but after the university it is debatable whether they are graduated as searching and asking individuals but it is for sure that not even half of the university graduates search for anything about their own branch or anything else Some opponents of this argument say that universities prepare students for real world and the reason for students not to be real searching individuals is that they must work in order to gain money and lead their lives so there is no time for them to deal with anything else Maybe they are right in this point but the universities fail to educate them as searching individuals because of universities education quality The system makes students to memorize everything because of this students knowledge goes to shortterm memory and after some time they forget what they learn Another reason for universities to be theoretical and not preparing students for real world is that there are huge differences among universities For example a student who is a graduate of Hacettepe University is not the same as the one who is a graduate of Harran University If they apply the same job of course Hacettepe University graduate will get the job It is because Hacettepe University has better education than Harran University So at this point we should ask some questions why are there such a huge difference between Hacettepe and Harran Universities Why arent they equal in their because it means also there are differences among the students In addition to all of these factors the biggest problem is that students cannot apply what they learn in the university outside For example Faculty of Education students take metodology and material development courses but these courses can be applied in ideal classes which consist of 20 students so that the teacher could be able to involve each student actively in the activities he or she prepares However when we have a look at the schools in our country we see that it is difficult and sometimes impossible to involve all the class actively in the activities because there are 3540 students in each class and maybe more in some schools Of course there are schools which have many opportunities for each student with their ideal classes but they are private schools and the ones who cannot pay for it cannot benefit their opportunities for this reason although universities have many opportunities in order to supply their students with a boundary of knowledge once they go outside and begin to work they see that there are not such opportunities because of some economical and political problems the country have To sum up although universities are democratic full of opportunities and broadening the point of view of their students it is the whole system itself with its economical political and historical deficiencies which is responsible for universities to be inefficient in preparing students for the real world First of all we should provide suitable working conditions and opportunities for students to be able to apply outside what they learn in the university and of course universities should be equal in their education quality Only then could we say that universities are indeed preparing students for the real world

point of view the improvement of a country at any field is parallel to its education level If the education level is high the country is also developed Thus the knowledge given in universities should be permanent in order to be used not only in education process but also in real life A wellequipped person is nothing without the practice of how to use her equipmentfor example you are fed up with education system And they mostly believe that practicality is needed for this system Otherwise students will not be prepared for the real life It will be difficult to find good jobs after they economical support In order to this people must believe that its really necessary to give importance to educational activities Otherwise people go to universities spend time money and effort in vain text_field: Talking about euthanasia is quite a thing specially when you are still a teen years away from the time when you should worry about death Anyway in spite of the subjective effect of age on the way we think about serious matters in life here is my most objective thought about it Whether we should or not decide when to die is not the real problem the fact that we should not is out of the question Obviously we should After all we are free beings or at least that is what modern society teaches us to be free In my opinion that involves taking decisions regarding our own bodies  and at our own risk Of course we humans are reluctant to die Even if we are religious people and believe in life after death we prefer not to take unnecessary risks and would probably give everything for a few more moments in this world But sometimes extreme situations could make us long for death A clear example imagine you are at war you have just been hit and are in great pain you know you will not survive Pain can easily make even the most conservative person cry for merciful killing It could also be the case of a person who thinks he has had enough of this world Why should anyone decide that this person must be kept alive until the Almighty decides to put his finger down If a persons wish is to live no more he should not be deprived of the right to take that resolution The real problem lies in what is call passive or negative euthanasia which involves not making the effort to prevent death It is the perfect alibi for a murderer From my point of view this is what the law should try to prevent When the only heir of a rich old man in deep coma suggest euthanasia distrust should grow The same situation could apply the other way round it might be the case that someone could find another persons death quite inconvenient To put it in a simple way having someone deciding who must live might be as dangerous as having someone deciding who must die In any case those are decisions that a person can take only about his  her own life There is also an ethical dilemma Euthanasia and also suicide are issues usually morally compared with abortion but there is a huge difference In the case of abortion another human life is being affected and that is a controversial topic In contrast euthanasia concerns only the person who chooses to do it Throughout history many cultures have accepted euthanasia as a normal act and many others have condemned it strongly specially Christian cultures  Following the same idea as before great care must be taken in distinguishing when someone is choosing death and when this really goes beyond a personal resolution The HaraKiri performed by the ancients Japanese was then used as a way of executing political opponents In the wrong hands euthanasia can be a really dangerous weapon just as death penalty can be  Summing up the risk of euthanasia is the possibility of using it as a form of destruction rather than allowing individuals the freedom to say here is as far as I go Not much will be achieved by making it illegal as that will not prevent people from commiting suicide or appealing to euthanasia Maybe the State should focus on rising the quality of life and the rate of artificial deaths will probably decrease

text_field: How much does a woman differ from a man This is the ultimate question of contemporary historical gender studies and it has no objective answers since most people consider a woman and a man as two opposing figures rather than two equal halves of a whole This supposed binary opposition is well seen in Western societies which are with no doubt male dominated However in Eastern philosophy especially in Taoism they are not in contrast with each other but considered as two equal parts of a whole In Western world people are taught that one of the integral parts of the dichotomies  black and white darkness and light female and male  is always superior to one another Light is always superior to darkness just as man is always superior to woman However in Taoist teaching dualism of these supposed dichotomies does not count while yin stands for femininity yang stands for the masculine half of the circle of life Yang is not more powerful than yin There is a balance between them that creates the piece in between Without one of them the circle is never complete that is to say in order to make a whole one needs the existence of the other one on equal grounds Moreover yin bears some of the attributions of yang and vice versa There is the blackness of yin within the borderline of yangs white The vice versa position also obeys the same pattern This shows that there is no clear cut between the attributions of both sexes Yin has a black point on her territory and yang has some whiteness on itself In short there is no clear cut distinction in between and one needs to have some of the attributes of the other one At this point lets go back to our question How much does a woman differ from a man Of course she does differ from men Her genital organs are quite diverse from that of a man Biologically she is the passive part in sexual union and she is also the one who has less physical strength What else She is at the same time the one who plays the part of breeding She is the productive side of the union Of course she cannot give birth to a child on her own But she spends almost a year in action in this process which finals in pain while her partner spends just a couple of minutes after all which he takes pleasure without any physical pain Lets try to answer another question Could this biological diversity be a means of social oppression The answer is Absolutely no  Then what gives the male the right to dominate This is a difficult question and it must be answered in historical terms In ancient times as historians agree upon the idea the primitive societies were matriarchal The women were in every phases of life the active part They were the ones who provided and preserved food They were the artisans of pottery which was useful enough to keep the food surplus They were the builders of houses They were the workers in the fields of grain after the Agricultural revolution They were in short the creators of life This is evident if a close study is done The deities of these good old times were all female There was Gaia  the earth mother Kibele and later on although mixed with male deities there was Hera Aphrodite Artemis and Demeter and so on Then as historians also claim they needed men to protect the food surplus from the outsiders Because they were stronger in physiological terms and they could at least keep safe the food produced by the females This task of protection later on gave way to organized armies whose members were all men and once they got the power they started to dominate That is why the later deities are male in their nature They were the strong muscled and aggressive heroes and their god could not be anything but an Almighty Lord And the Almighty  Zeus or Allah or Jehovah had to establish hierarchy so as to carry on his power Eve had had to be the cause of Original Sin or who else could be Adam No he could not Because he was male and he could only be a victim of the demonic female History is a means of understanding todays facts The Almighty is still the reigning figure in all aspects of life There is still patriarchy in most of the societies The women are considered to be subservient to men Moreover some women also think in this way They are still the Cinderella Snowwhites and the Sleeping Beauties They wait for the prince to awaken and rescue them and then choose them as prospective wives However time has changed and there is less and less need to physical power of men to protect their people So there is no need for male dominance This is not the time of the preagricultural Revolution as well There is no need to have any privileged sociosexual classes It is the time of equality Today any women can use a computer as good as a man she can also draw architectural graphs and become an academician unless she is equally educated with men She can also write good poetry novels dramas and articles as intelligently as a man does since talent is not a miracle of sexuality She can also teach and learn She is also talented in almost all deeds of life and can be even better than men in their fields at times unless she is given the opportunity especially the opportunity to have a room of her own

Title: Nuclear Energy
text_field: Life has never been the same since that event since the first atomic bombs were dropped on Hiroshima and Nagasaki just fifty seven years ago It killed over one hundred thousand people at the end of World War ll It was such a view that none of the science fiction writers could dream of it But can this event make us ignore the necessity of the nuclear power From microwave ovens to electrical power and nuclear medicine to ships that can sail the seas for as long as twelve years without refueling the nuclear power provides a beter life for many of the inhabitants of the earth The same power is used today to detect genetic disorders in unborn children or to destroy a malignant cancer cell Have you ever heard or seen a high speed train travelling around the world It is said that this train is powered by the equivalent of the energy contained in a glass of water and it is claimed that this energy which is won by harnessing the power of the atom would be cheap efficient clean and above all safe Of course some protest compaigns occured for this project The first ones came from the people who only see the warlike side of nuclear power The inhabitants of villages through which such trains passed as they feared that in the event of a collision the containers of radioactive substances would break and spill radiation onto surrounding houses and countryside But the railway authorities were fairly successful in reducing such fears and showing that the containers they used could never break not even in a collision So we can see that concern is almost never directed at the power stations themselves and we are assured that scientists had foreseen everything that could possibly go wrong and taken the necessary precautions Besides since nuclear power will take place of the coal men would not have to labour beneath the ground in dirty and dangerous conditions to win the coal which would fuel our industry The nuclear power stations of the future would not cause a decrease in the worlds natural resources since they do not depend on burning fossil fuels like coal or oil Thus our resources would last much longer Of course these ones are not working yet but they are the things that the nuclear power can make real While sitting in our houses at nights watching television or listening to music or just sitting in a lighted room who wants to be plunged suddenly into darkness which may last for hours Who wants to sit in a dark room without watching TV or without listening to music or without everything that we can do by the electricity This would be a common occurence unless the nuclear energy is used Another benefit of the nuclear energy is its being emissionfree So this side of the nuclear energy prevents the atmospheric pollution To sum up we can say that the nuclear power has a peaceful as well as a warlike side and the vigorous development of nuclear energy is not a matter of choice but of necessity Nuclear energy should be used in countries which it is not used and it should continue to be used in countries which it is used It is plentiful inexpensive and emissionfree New technology is continually being developed to handle the problem of wastes Reactors are becoming safer and more efficient Without nuclear energy atmospheric pollution and the cost of electricity will continue to rise

text_field: Animal testing is a subject which can cause a great response in many people Animal testing is a practice to discover the cause and effects of a disease and test potential treatment for disease A drug is first tested on animals which can be used to produce similar physiology to the disease in humans If these trials are successful the drug will then go on to human trials The questions cortisone causes birth defects in mice but not in humans Aspirin poisons cats If the results of tests on animals had been relied on we would not have aspirin Certain adrenaline insulin and some antibiotics are also toxic to many animals but they are beneficial to humans There are many alternatives to animal testing which are as accurate and they should be used instead These alternatives Title: Sex Equality
text_field: The purpose of my article is to show the role of women and men sex equality in contemporary Turkish society Like most countries in the Middle East Turkey is a patriarchal society However when compared to most countries in the region women have more rights thanks to the reform implemented by Kemal Ataturk Ill mention about education employment poverty and development Women in Turkey gained many rights at the same time of the formation of the Turkish Republicearlier than women in many westrn countries These rights and freedoms have increased over the past 80 years However the traditional structure of society prevents many women from using their legal rights In addition existing laws are inadequate to deal with changing world conditions In order to improve womens status increase their participation in development and improve indicators in the areas of education health labour force participation and social security it is now necessary to revise aspects of the law that stand in the way of malefemale equality The underdevelopment phenomenon that characterizes the social structure in Turkey immediately reflects itself in gender inequality in education The main reasons for this inequality are the use of limited economic resources selectively a continuation of patriarchal values  and as a result of increasing internal migration and rapid urbanization social and cultural inconsistencies regional disparities and increasing influence of religious education over the secular educational institutions Even though public schools were established quite early in Turkey girls were first incorporated into the formal educational system in 1869 The foundation of todays formal education system was laid out in a law passed in 1924In the first twenty years of the Republic girls rights in terms of formal and nonformal education steadily increased However the educational level of girls and the number of girls educated have remained lower than those of boys According to the 1990 census the numbers of men and women who have graduated from primary school are just about equal in fact the numbers of women are slightly higher than the numbers of men However there is a big difference in primary school attendance between rural and urban males this difference is significant for females with girls in rural areas having a lower attendance rate In rural areas girls education is not seen as important and boys education is favored Girls may be denied this right because they are expected to stay home and help with housework or because their homes are far from schools In addition girls births are not always officially registered and therefore they may not be required to attend school On the other hand despite the consensus by all concerned over the importance of womens participation in the labor force for women themselves as well as their families and the national economy effective measures towards this end have not been taken Therefore increasing womens employment in jobs with social security ensuring that women enter the work life as qualified and skilled labor developing the necessary training programs to this effect remain basic targets In the recent years in order to encourage womens participation in employment certain incentives have been introduced to support women to start a business However this has been confined to traditional activities aimed at making contributions to the family budget Moreover since credits are extended though bank loans and women face a number of obstacles in receiving these credits as mentioned in earlier sections the initiative has been less than effective As we know Turkey is one of the few countries where food self sufficiency is achieved Therefore it is not possible to talk about overall starvation and absolute poverty However due to high population increase integration into market economy which brings with it economic fluctuations uncertainties and inequalities and the inability of the system to generate sufficient employment opportunities there is widespread relative poverty The ways in which women experience poverty differs in rural and urban contexts Due to poverty permanent and seasonal migration of men has become a lifestyle The women pass their lives waiting for their husbands who come home once in a while while their children grow up more or less without their fathers This is yet another dimension of the problem of rural poverty for women A radical solution to this caused by rapid population growth and structural transformations in agriculture appears to be possible through the establishments of rural industries which can create local employment opportunities for rural labor Therefore on the one hand a gradual shift from unproductive agricultural enterprises towards the non agricultural sector will be encouraged The dwellers of the  live at the margin of the urban standards As such their needs and demands are determined within a different frame of reference and since they maintain a strong linkage with their village they tend to have diverse and flexible sources of livelihood Therefore despite all the adverse conditions in the   this marginality in fact offers alternative strategies to women in making ends meet towards family subsistence Whereas the low and fixed income families living in the city proper are the most constrained by urban poverty The women in this families must perform miracles to maintain the household sustenance Thus in both rural and urban areas poor women do not have the opportunity to earn an income which will enable them to live as dependent individuals Furthermore the responsibility they carry in managing limited household resources places the weight of poverty most intensely on their shoulders As a conclusion the variety and accessibility of contraceptive of methods should be increased regional and rural  urban differences in service delivery and utilization should be reduced information and counseling should be incorporated into all stages of service delivery the knowledge and skills of service provides should be improved importance should be given to infection control during service delivery

is no logical place to draw the line Also people need not be killed to put them out of their misery when they are seriously ill Almost all pain can be relieved by modern medical techniques  so it is not necessary to kill patients who cant be cured But must a doctor use extraordinary or heroic means to save every life even when the patient is deathly ill In my opinion extraordinary or heroic treatment need not be used when the chance for recovery is poor and medical treatment would serve only to prolong the dying process But to deny customary and reasonable care or to deliberately starve someone because he or she is very old or very ill should not be permitted Anyway the doctor must do his best to save his patients life I sometimes think whether euthanasia is legal or not  I searched text_field: Euthanasia is the act of killing an individual for the reason of mercy This paper will examine the issue of active and passive euthanasia Active euthanasia is an intervention that would cause death to take place when it would not otherwise happen Passive euthanasia is the decision to withold help from an individual ultimately leading to the death of the individual Death being a choice indicates that a decision must be made The decision therefore lies in the hands of the patient because he has a natural right to his life and his body This right to life is selfevident and universal The problem with this argument becomes evident when the patient is not able to present a desicision whether he is unconscious or has other inabilities of communication or thought processes Who then if anybody should make the decision between intervention preventing death or intervention causing death Consent then is the issue that I will base the moral permissibility of euthanasia on Should euthanasia be morally okay with consent without consent both or neither First I will argue that euthanasia is morally permissible I have mentioned that death is a choice Accepting this viewpoint you accept that someone should be able to decide to die Accepting this then you justify suicide This argument is not based upon suffering because I have drawn no definition to the acceptable limit of suffering If suicide is okay then why not assisted suicide Remember that just standing idle when you could prevent death is a decision to allow suicide Arranging an injection with a push button so all the patient has to do is push a button to die would be considered suicide which is morally acceptable This would mean that it is acceptable for an individual to die if they were physically capable of doing it themselves What logic would you deny the same right to those who were mentally competant but physically incapable A person who is physically incapable of killing themselves must be killed by another if they choose to die If a person has a right to die and cannot physically kill themselves than euthanasia is the only way they could excersise their choice to death If a person wants to die because they are in a unfavorable condition whether the choice to die is implied by the patient at the present or by instructions previously given they have a right to chose to die and their choice should be honored Therefore I believe that euthanasia with consent in one way or another is morally permissible in most circumstances The moral permissibility of euthanasia without consent now must be considered Everybody has a right to chose to die if they want to Who is to chose whether a person should die or not when the person cannot make the decision on their own and their was no previous decision made If no decision was previously made and no consent can be given at the present time than can a decision be made on the life or death of another Unless we are willing to prevent death with every means available for every individual we choose to exercise choice over death The reasons we make those choices are varied and often ones we are not willing to face Killing to end the pain and suffering of the one being killed could be one of the most noble choices we could make I believe that in cases where no consent can be given a decision must be made to intervene to prevent death or to intervene and cause death  	The decision making itself is moral because death is a choice The person or people who make the decision will vary with each circumstance I believe that if the person is in experiencing pain and suffering then the euthanasia would be morally permissible even when no consent can be given To sum up my argument thus far I have come to the conlusion that euthanasia with consent and euthanasia without consent in most circumstanes would be morally permissible I have come to the conclusion that death is a choice Passive and active euthanasia are both decisions leading to death and therefore are both morally permissible because they excersise death as a choice A choice must be made to intervene to prevent death and to intervene to cause death This choice may be based on consent of an individual or in cases where no consent can be given the condition of the individual An opposition to my argument would be that death is not a choice and everything must be done to prevent death from occuring This argument may be backed up by the value of life because life is a good that is desirable to pursue or possess If death was not a choice then the right to chose to die and in turn the morallity of euthanasia would not be permissible In this viewpoint a person could not chose to die and that everything must be done to preserve life While it is true that life is a valuable thing to possess it might only be valuable in certain circumstances If a person is suffering from chronic pain then is the persons life really valuable if even the person himself does not hold any value in it If the persons life is not valuable any longer in this situation then why must the persons life be preserved by all means The argument is based on the value of life The value of life is the supposed reason of the argument that death is not a choice Now that I have argued that life is not always a valuable commodity then death is a choice

Title: Euthanasia
text_field: Should euthanasia be legalized We put animals out of their misery rather than let them suffer intolerable pain so why let human beings suffer the same amount of pain Here is where I will introduce the practice of euthanasia Euthanasia is the humanitarian means to end unnecessary pain and suffering in human beings It is stated that the doctor has the ability to end or alleviate the patients suffering by prescribing any treatment that is appropriate However if the patient will eventually die through the suffering of the illness they are experiencing what should the doctors reaction be  My personal opinion is one that if strict legal precautions are observed  a doctor should be able to exercise the choice of executing the act of administrating euthanasia The act of applying euthanasia or otherwise known as a mercy killing  can release a dying patient from an unbearable agony  and it will let them die in a peaceful and painless way For example  a victim who has been fatally injured in an accident  and in order to lessen his inevitable pain the victim should be given the right to end his life legally The patient himself should be the judge of whether his or her life has become intolerable not the doctor who is doing the operation If the individual wishes to be released from the suffering he is experiencing  I believe that it should not be denied Also in the case of an incurable terminal illness  euthanasia would be the only solution When a patient or the family members ask for a mercy killing  and when the doctors feel that the act is justified it should be carried out with legal permission When this act is requested by both the patient and the family members then the abuse of freely administrating euthanasia will be prevented This cooperation between the patient and the family and a law stating so  can also minimize the chance that the doctor will not abuse this privilege If a patient should prefer death to living in torment  then this person should not be forced to live unhappily or unnecessarily When a person asks for euthanasia  the decision is not born out of frustration and emotion  The decision to end ones life is made out of careful consideration  and the desire to end the pain  There are some people that think that doctors do not always correctly estimate a patients recuperative abilities  and thereby should not make the decision to end the patients life However we should keep in mind that its the patients decision that makes the difference to end his own life  We also should remember that since the doctor is giving treatment to the patient  we can have confidence that the Professional knowledge of the doctor is to be trusted Otherwise we will not let the doctor give the cure that is best suited to help the patient Also under their professional judgement the doctor can not be said to be a murderer Thirdly there are burdens that weigh on the family of the patient who has requested euthanasia that weigh heavily upon them One of the burdens that rest upon the family is the financial aspect  If the patient has requested euthanasia as a last desire I believe that the burden of paying for the operation should not wholly rest on the patients family Yes the fee for this operation is costly  but I believe that there should be an insurance policy that covers this decision Another burden that lies on the family is the pain that they are going through as their loved one suffers unnecessarily They do not need to go through the pain of seeing a loved one wither away when a solution can be had The solution is euthanasia Through a person is proclaimed terminally ill with cancer or AIDS with no hope of recovery should they end their life However doctors are not always correct with the analysis of patients recuperative powers I am not saying all of a sudden they become cured of such disease but perhaps less pain and problems  so they can carry out normal life Also  who is to say we wont find a cure or prevention for such diseases We are always trying to find new methods and cures to help such people Another point is our society is always looking for a quick way out instead of sticking it through  This is just another easy way out for people this time its life though  a more permanent decision In conclusion  I believe that euthanasia should be legalized albeit be under strict control  This practice releases the patients pain  and also along with the family members burden  Although the patients seem to have the right to end their own lives  I highly suggest that thinking should be thoroughly done before making any type of this kind of decision In the future  I hope that advancing technology will bring an end to all suffering of this kind

Title: Most university degrees are theoretical and do not prepare students for the real world. They are therefore of very little value
text_field: I am a third class student in ELT department and when I ask my self about the quality of the education that I have been taking  I realize that it is mostly full of theoretical information and university education does not prepare me for real conditions In an other word university education does not provide me with the necessary experiences for teaching satisfactorily in the future This situation decreases the value and importance of university education in my mind So in some aspects I agree with the idea that most university degrees are theoretical and do not prepare students for real world They are there for of little value The main reason for thinking so is poorly designed lesson plans of universities The chief reason decreasing the value of university education is insufficient lesson plans I think being a good teacher has some important components such as knowing your subject very well  knowing how to teach it to the students  being able to sympathize with students  being able solve different problems etc    Sometimes I ask that how many of these features we will have when we graduate from the university as English teachers As first I think of our subject  namely English It could be possible to accept that at university we learn English in a sufficient way In an other word we have the first feature  adequate knowledge of our subject  of a good teacher But when we ask about the other components of the ideal teacher it impossible to say that we gain those features during our university education  because lessons such as teaching methods and education psychology taught at universities are designed in a poor way  and so these lessons can not go further than providing students with theoretical information They are just theoretical because  these classes are designed just for the ideal situation  for situation that is supposed to be  but not for the real situation For example in method classes we are taught a set of teaching method We study what these methods aim  what kind of activities they consist of  but we do not cover what kind of problems we will have while using these methods Moreover we do not have the practicing these methods in real situations In order to practice these methods we have some micro teaching experiences But these micro sessions are so far from real conditions that we get nearly any profit of them In this sessions our objects are our classmates so the level is very high and we do not have any problem while experiencing the methods Every thing goes in a perfect way so we are not able to learn what kind problems we will face while using these methods  what kind of questions we will be asked  in which part of the subject students will have difficulty to understand etc     Since we do not have any problem in micro sessions  we do not know what to do when students come up with an unexpected question  how to answer it When I start to teach in a school and when I face many unpredictable questions  reactions etc    since at the university I am not prepared such kind of situations we will have to produce our own method and we will keep the methods that we study at university just as inadequate information An other example of poorly designed lessons is education psychology classes These classes aim to teach us sympathizing with our students  understanding their psychology feeling etc    In these classes the general image of our object  namely the image of our students is thought as the perfect children who are eager to learn whatever we telling But in real situation we will deal with many different personalities and it certain that all of them wont be wonderful children We will have problems with our students and we are not given any advice about what we should do when one of our students breaks the concentration of whole class in an unacceptable way or how we should react when a student reject to listen to the lesson  etc    Shortly education psychology classes just provides us with insufficient information As conclusion I can say that as a result of poorly designed lesson plans of universities  we will graduate from university as insufficient English teachers When we face a problem with our students  our inadequate method an psychology classes wont be able to help us and at this point we will try to remember what our primary or secondary school teachers used to do to solve problems or to teach a subject etc    In an other word we will probably be a apprentices of our exteachers rather than university graduated teachers as result of theoretical lesson plans of universities

inheritence women may not work without their husbands permission This thought changed by the Womens Liberation Movement This movement was established to change the role of women in society Women should receive the same treatment as men in education work opportunities and politics and that the same moral standards should be applied to both sexes For example in the workplace women who work outside the home were heavily concentrated in the lowest paying work and that having the lowest status Women also earned less than men in the same kind of jobs The median pay of women workers in the Middle Ages they produced much of what was needed in the home and also made items for sale in the marketplace One of the most important unequality between men and women is that women dont have the right to vote Women want to vote as men because they are the members of the country too Womens call for the vote was first answered in New Zealand in 1893 In spite of all their struggles only in 1918 women got the vote in Britain The US followed in 1920 In Turkey women got the vote in 1934 by Atatürk Although they got the vote its also rare to see the women in political areas One of the reasons is the small number of women in discipline because women are unwelcome in such a maledominated subject or they are thought to be inappropriate for the study of politics For example when Tansu Çiller was chosen as the first Prime Minister in Turkey people all over the country were surprised This shows the victory of Womens Liberation Movement on equal rights of women This shows that both men and women are equal in every part of society In spite of all changes women rights it is still difficult to think of many successful women in business or industry The main reason for this is that married women rather than their husbands suffer the career penalties of producing and raising children If a woman wants to have a career on her business life she can do this after having a baby This is an handicap for women who want to be equal with men Families are the big effects on womens future too Although girls tend to perform better at school they are often encouraged to specialize in humanities subjects Title: Animal testing
text_field: Using animals for testing is wrong and should be banned They have rights just as we do Twentyfour hours a day humans are using defenseless animals for cruel and most often useless tests single life or benefit humans in anyway at all but the same can be sad for tens of thousands of other experiments performed each year Note that all of these experiments according to the experimenters own reports obviously caused the animals to suffer before dying No steps were taken to prevent this suffering even when it was clear that the radiation or poison had made the animals extremely sick Also these experiments are parts of series of similar experiments repeated with only minor variations that are being carried out all over the world These experiments DO NOT save human lives or improve them in any way In any case as the differing results they obtained on pigs and dogs make it clear it is not possible to reach any firm conclusion about the effects of a substance on humans from tests spray lipstick nail polish and lots of other products There is a horrifying test a chemist working in a cosmetics company reported in Discovery Channel named the Drazie Test The Drazie test is performed exclusively on albino rabbits They are preferred because they are cheap and their eyes do not shed tears  so chemicals placedin them do not wash out They are also the test subject of choice because their eyes are clear making it easier to observe destruction of eye tissue their corneal membranes are more susceptible to injury During each test the rabbits are immobilizied usually in a stack with only their heads moving and a solid or liquid is placed in the lower lid of one eye of each rabbit These substances can range from mascara to aftershave to oven cleaner The rabbits eyes remain clipped open Anesthesia is almost never used After that the rabbits are examined at intervals of one twentyfour fortyeight seventytwo and one hundred and sixtyeight hours Some studies continue for a period of weeks no other attempt is made to treat the rabbits or to seek any antidotes The rabbits who survive the Drazie test may then be used as subjects for skininflammation tests In conclusion every day of the year hundreds of thousands of fully conscious animals are scalded or beaten or crushed to death and more are subjected to exotic surgery and then allowed to die slowly
